title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garrett Wilson (concussion) practices Thursday
items.desc: Garrett Wilson was practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Wilson was not wearing the red jersey, a good sign for his status as he remains in concussion protocol. He continues to trend in the right direction.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Micah Parsons was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Parsons missed practice on Wednesday due to an illness. He is expected to progress to team drills this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Sean Rhyan remained sidelined from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Rhyan was hopeful to return this week. He would likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jenkins missed practice to start the week. His return on Thursday is a good sign for his status heading into Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Burton (calf) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Michael Burton did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Burton misses back-to-back practices to begin the week. He will need to be monitored on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Hickman Jr. (concussion) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Ronnie Hickman Jr. is not practicing again on Thursday.
items.impact: Hickman remains in concussion protocol. He seems unlikely to play in Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Denzel Boston (toe) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Denzel Boston did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Boston misses back-to-back practices to start the week. He will need to be monitored on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) not seen practicing Thursday
items.desc: Chris Bell was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Bell was limited in practice on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Brewer (concussion) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Aaron Brewer did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brewer was placed in concussion protocol to begin the week. He is trending in the wrong direction heading into Sunday's game against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Woody Marks suffers knee injury in practice Wednesday, status uncertain
items.desc: Woody Marks dealt with mild knee discomfort Wednesday in practice and didn't finish practice for precautionary reasons.
items.impact: Marks was not seen to begin practice on Thursday. He will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin/personal) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair remained absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Al-Shaair misses his second straight practice to begin the week. He'll need to be monitored on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Smack (calf) to log full practice Thursday
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Trey Smack will be full go in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Smack was limited in practice on Wednesday. His right calf injury doesn't seem to be a concern.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) to undergo surgery Friday
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Josh Jacobs will have finger surgery on Friday.
items.impact: Once Jacobs undergoes the surgery, Jacobs will have a more clear timetable for his return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Parker II has practice window opened
items.desc: The Bengals opened the practice window of OL Brian Parker II.
items.impact: Parker landed on injured reserve ahead of Week 1. He will have 21 days to be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Davis has practice window opened
items.desc: The Bengals opened the practice window for CB Jalen Davis.
items.impact: Davis played in the first three games and has been out with a hamstring injury. He will have 21 days to be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keylan Rutledge (neck/shoulder) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Keylan Rutledge was not seen at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Rutledge did not practice on Wednesday. He is trending in the wrong direction heading into Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) working off to side during practice Thursday
items.desc: David Montgomery was dressed out but working off to the side during practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Montgomery did not practice on Wednesday. He is trending towards missing another game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) works off to side in practice Thursday
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson was working off to the side during practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Stevenson did not practice on Wednesday. He is trending in the wrong direction heading into Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee) practices Thursday
items.desc: A.J. Brown was seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown was officially limited in practice on Wednesday. He will need to be monitored on Thursday's injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrei Iosivas (thumb) has practice window opened
items.desc: The Bengals designated Andrei Iosivas to return from injured reserve.
items.impact: Iosivas will return to practice for the first time since injuring his thumb in Week 2. He'll have 21 days to be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harrison Mevis signs with Ravens practice squad
items.desc: The Ravens signed K Harrison Mevis to their practice squad.
items.impact: Riley Patterson signed with the Ravens active roster. Both kickers will figure to compete for the starting role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daiyan Henley will not be traded to Broncos
items.desc: The Broncos deal for Dayian Henley is off and will not be finalized.
items.impact: The Broncos said Tuesday that it was pending a physical. It appears that may have been the issue. He will remain with the Chargers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brevin Jordan (finger/foot) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Brevin Jordan did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jordan remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jackson Meeks signs with Lions
items.desc: The Lions signed Jackson Meeks to their practice squad.
items.impact: Meeks returns to Detroit after he was waived by them and cleared waivers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyu Blu Kelly signs with Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers signed Kyu Blu Kelly.
items.impact: Kelly will add depth for the Chargers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zion Childress signs with Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers signed Zion Childress.
items.impact: Childress was released by the Panthers last week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Ross signs with Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings signed LB Josh Ross.
items.impact: Ross will add depth in the linebacker room for Minnesota.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Damon Bankston signs with Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings signed RB Damon Bankston.
items.impact: Bankston will add depth in the backfield for Minnesota.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. signs with Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings signed WR Odell Beckham Jr. to their practice squad.
items.impact: Beckham will continue to add depth in the wide receiver room for Minnesota.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Pyburn signs with Chiefs
items.desc: The Chiefs signed Jack Pyburn to their practice squad.
items.impact: Pyburn was waived by Kansas City and cleared waivers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Carter has practice window opened
items.desc: The Cardinals opened the practice window of DL Zach Carter.
items.impact: Carter will have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hunter Long has practice window opened
items.desc: The Cardinals opened the practice window of TE Hunter Long.
items.impact: Long will have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamaree Salyer signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed OL Jamaree Salyer to their practice squad.
items.impact: Salyer will add depth on the offensive line for Arizona.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Jones signs with 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers signed CB Jack Jones to the team's practice squad.
items.impact: Jones will add depth to the corner back room for San Francisco.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: B.J. Green II has practice window opened
items.desc: The Jaguars opened the practice window for DE B.J. Green II.
items.impact: Green will have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Wilson (neck) will not require surgery
items.desc: Cardinals WR Michael Wilson does not need surgery on his fractured neck.
items.impact: Wilson will let the injury heal on its own. It is a good sign for his status heading into his next season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Whittington (back) placed on IR
items.desc: The Rams placed WR Jordan Whittington on injured reserve.
items.impact: Whittington will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: CJ Donaldson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Donaldson remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordyn Tyson to get 'a healthy dose more' snaps in Week 10
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Jordyn Tyson should get "a healthy dose more" snaps in Week 10 against the Panthers.
items.impact: Tyson is not on the injury report to begin the week. He will be an upside WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Zachariah Branch did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Branch missed last week due to a hamstring injury he suffered in Week 8. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. (groin) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Fannin is on track to be good to go in Week 10 for the Browns. He remains a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tank Dell (hand/shoulder) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tank Dell was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dell is coming off a big performance last week. He'll be an upside WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Harrison is on track to be good to go in Week 10. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hunter Henry (foot) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Hunter Henry was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Henry played through the injury last week. He should be on track to be good to go in Week 10.
